scope: Static direct-DC empty-secret branch of the pinned official Android ARM64 binary

completeBufferFramingFollowup.scope: Offline inspection of the pinned ARM64 request writer, initial receive branch, and native keepalive classes. No code execution from the APK or network requests.

outgoingHeader.writer: Datacenter::createRequestsData offsets1148..1232; it serializes the socket wrapper after the five fields.
outgoingHeader.userIdProof: ConnectionsManager::setUserId schedules a callable at vtable address point 0x18f3f88. Its operator at 0xd5e488 stores the supplied ID to manager+0x518 at offset20, the same field read by createRequestsData at offset1148.

receiveBoundary.constructorEvidence: Connection::Connection loads an eight-byte constant 01 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 from rodata 0x14b71a0 at offsets76..80, then stores it to this+0x1f0 at offset100.
receiveBoundary.socketHandoff: ConnectionSocket::onEvent calls recv at offset156, sets the buffer limit to its returned length at offset204, and the ordinary branch at offsets1840..1856 passes the same buffer to the virtual method at address-point+0x10. ELF relocation 0x18f6d70 resolves this slot to Connection::onReceivedData.
receiveBoundary.ordinaryDispatch: Connection::onReceivedData reads the selector at offset700. The nonzero path sets length argument zero at offset728 and dispatches the current buffer to ConnectionsManager::onConnectionDataReceived at offsets844..872. The manager reads i64 message ID at offset164, i32 sequence at offset248, and u32 TL constructor at offset264.
receiveBoundary.alternateDispatch: Selector zero enters a separate abridged byte/0x7f word-count branch at offsets1008..1104, and handles a big-endian quick acknowledgement at offsets1204..1272. This is distinct from the observed initial selector.
receiveBoundary.limitation: The initial ordinary receive branch does not establish a robust TCP split/coalesced-packet decoder. Do not assume an incoming 32-byte request-style header, a length prefix on this branch, or a guaranteed one-frame-per-recv boundary. An actual capture is still needed to establish the service's record boundaries.

keepalive.source: ConnectionsManager::sendPing loads the TL_ping_delay_disconnect vtable via GOT relocation 0x19389f8 at offset120, fills ping ID and delay, and calls generateMessageSeqNo(false) at offsets448..452.
keepalive.responseEvidence: TL_ping_delay_disconnect::deserializeResponse tail-calls TL_pong::TLdeserialize. The latter matches constructor 0x347773c5 and reads two i64 fields at offsets88 and104.
keepalive.limitation: The prior credential-free HTTP400 classification used the separate TL_ping constructor; it tested listener framing, not exact parity with this keepalive path.

syntheticCompleteBufferVectors.scope: Deterministic source-shaped vectors validated in memory. Empty account fields, synthetic IDs, sequence zero and delay35 for the request. The response is an illustrative complete buffer rather than captured provider traffic.

limitations: No claim about every Eitaa transport, alternate authenticated TLS paths or all APK branches; no live socket probe, no downgrade, no APK code execution. Existing HTTPS login is a separate path.
